propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless, hiding the reason field (bound-exceeded vs signal-unavailable) that autodeploy.sh already stamps, making cloudwatch-only diagnosis impossible

bound-exceeded (reviews still in flight after defer max) and signal-unavailable (health probe broken, deploys run blind) require opposite remediation but cannot be distinguished from the current metric

observability.sh must emit two new separate metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by pattern-matching the reason field from journal markers, while preserving the rolled-up review_interrupts total

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms keeping identical 900s/1-datapoint cadence, each carrying only its own remediation, so signal-unavailable remains promptly alarming
a test suite must prove the split counts correctly and the rolled-up total equals the sum, including the piranha case of all bound-exceeded firings leaving signal-unavailable at zero
terraform apply must be executed post-merge to replace the old alarm with the two new reason-scoped alarms on the live account
